style_notes: Analog 35mm film photography, Kodak Portra 400 grain structure, heavily muted desaturated palette. Abstract and conceptual — never literal, never illustrative. No people, no faces, no obvious religious iconography. Evoke emotional and theological truth through texture, light, shadow, and negative space alone. Think Alabaster Books meets Kinfolk magazine: spare, intimate, unhurried. Objects minimal or absent. Light does the storytelling.
color_palette: Bleached linen, weathered stone, faded terracotta, dry grass, bone white, ash gray, deep shadow — all heavily desaturated with analog film warmth

images.title: Sabbath Healing
images.concept: Watched for a stumble, given healing instead — the Sabbath as the day most fit for release
images.imageAlt: A bowl of still water on a stone floor, the water's surface perfectly still, morning light reflected in it from a high window
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a simple clay bowl filled with still clear water sitting on a worn stone floor, the water's surface perfectly undisturbed, reflecting a small bright rectangle from a high window not visible in frame, the reflection carrying the entire light of the image, the surrounding stone floor in soft shadow, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain in the stone, muted palette of pale clay and cool water, the still water on the day of rest — healing as the fulfillment of what the day was for, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: Humility and True Hospitality
images.concept: Take the lowest place — and the host's invitation to rise becomes the point
images.imageAlt: A long stone banquet table with place settings, the seats closest to viewer simple and rough, those at the far end more prominent
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a long ancient stone or rough wooden table seen from one end in perspective, simple rough wooden seats or benches in the near foreground and progressing toward more substantial seating in the distance, the table surface worn and honest, no food or elaborate settings — just the seats in their hierarchy made visible by perspective and the quality of the furniture, soft warm even light along the table length, heavy film grain, muted warm palette, the spatial argument of honor made visible, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: The Great Banquet
images.concept: The invited refused, the uninvited brought in — the feast that happens despite the refusals
images.imageAlt: An elaborately set stone table with multiple clay cups and bread, all prepared and waiting, completely empty of guests, warm evening light
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, a long stone table fully set for a feast — multiple clay cups, rough flatbread portions, simple vessels — all carefully arranged and waiting, the table completely empty of any guests, warm amber evening light falling across the full length of the table from the side, the preparations complete and the chairs empty, heavy Kodak Portra 400 grain, muted warm palette of clay and stone and amber light, the readied table awaiting unexpected guests, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9

images.title: The Cost of Discipleship
images.concept: Count the cost before laying the foundation — discipleship as full deliberate surrender, not impulsive enthusiasm
images.imageAlt: An unfinished stone foundation in open ground, the first courses laid precisely but the structure abandoned, overgrown at its edges
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, an unfinished stone foundation visible in open dry ground, the first several courses of stones carefully and precisely laid but the construction abandoned before the structure could rise, dry grass and small plants growing at the edges of the foundation stones, warm afternoon light across the abandoned construction, heavy film grain, muted palette of pale stone and dry vegetation, the begun and abandoned foundation — a cautionary study in what was not counted, Kinfolk editorial restraint, 16:9

images.title: Salt
images.concept: Salt that has lost its saltiness — the disciple without distinctive character, good for nothing
images.imageAlt: A small pile of salt on dark stone, the salt losing definition at its edges, dissolving into the wet stone
images.prompt: 35mm analog film photograph, close macro view of a small pile of pale salt crystals on dark wet stone, the salt pile sharp and crystalline at its center but dissolving and losing definition at its edges where moisture has begun to break it down, the dark stone around it showing the moisture, raking side light catching the crystal facets at the pile's center, heavy film grain in the dark stone, muted palette of pale salt white and dark wet stone, the salt disappearing into the surface — usefulness conditional on remaining what it is, Alabaster Books aesthetic, 16:9
